response.sql: WITH invoice_averages AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS average_quantity, (SUM(derived_product_cost) - SUM(derived_total_cost)) / NULLIF(SUM(derived_total_cost), 0) AS cost_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_quantity) AS overall_average_quantity FROM invoice_averages) SELECT i.invoice_number, i.average_quantity, i.cost_ratio, i.average_quantity - o.overall_average_quantity AS quantity_difference FROM invoice_averages AS i CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE i.average_quantity > o.overall_average_quantity ORDER BY quantity_difference IS NULL, quantity_difference DESC LIMIT 10;
